INCIDENT TYPE:
DISTRIBUTED DENIAL OF SERVICE (DDoS)

DESCRIPTION:
A Distributed Denial of Service attack attempts to overwhelm systems, applications, or networks with traffic from multiple sources, causing service disruption or complete unavailability.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1498 | Network Denial of Service

INDICATORS:
- Sudden traffic spikes
- Service degradation
- High bandwidth utilization
- Large numbers of requests
- Network congestion

DETECTION RULES:
- Traffic spikes
- Connection floods
- Unusual protocol usage

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Websites
- APIs
- Network infrastructure
- Cloud services
title: DISTRIBUTED DENIAL OF SERVICE (DDoS)
